senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; cmp. אִישׁ)being, substance, wealth (of knowledge &c.).
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 5:6:3">Y. Ned. V, end, 39ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Sukkah 28a:7">Succ. 28ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Batra 134a:8">B. Bath. 134ᵃ</cite> (<cite ref="Proverbs 8:21">Prov. VIII, 21</cite>, applied to R. Joh. b. Zaccai).
<cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 6:4">Ber. VI, 4</cite> <he>אם יש ביניהם וכ׳</he> if there is among them one species &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Peah 8:8">Peah VIII, 8</cite> <he>מי שיש לו וכ׳</he> he who possesses &c.
<cite ref="Chagigah 14b:4">Ḥag. 14ᵇ</cite> <he>יש נאה דורש וכ׳</he> many a one preaches well but does not act well; a. v. fr.—<he>יש אומרים</he> (abbr. <he>י״א</he>) some say (anonymous authority).
<cite ref="Horayot 13b:17">Hor. 13ᵇ</cite> <he>אסיקו … ולר׳ נתן י״א</he> the editors introduced ‘others say’ for R. M. and ‘some say’ for R. Nathan.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 93b:5">B. Bath. 93ᵇ</cite> <he>וי״א אף הוצאה</he> and some say, he must indemnify him also for carrying the seed out; <he>מאן י״א</he> who is meant by ‘some say’? (v. Tosaf. a. l.).
Ab. V, 6; a. v. fr.—יֶשְׁנוֹ he is, it is.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kiddushin 1:10">Kidd. I, 10</cite> <he>כל שי׳ במקרא וכ׳</he> whosoever is (engaged) in the study of the Bible &c.
Ḥag. 4ᵇ כל שי׳ בביאה י׳ וכ׳ whosoever is bound to visit the Temple, is also bound &c., v. הֲבָאָה; a. fr.—יֶשְׁנָהּ she is, it is.

<cite ref="Kiddushin 48a:8">Kidd. 48ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>י׳ לשכירות וכ׳</he> the relation of employment exists from beginning to end, i.e. the employer is under obligation for every portion of the contracted labor, opp. <he>אינה ל׳ … אלא בסוף</he> the obligation takes effect only when the work is finished; a. fr.
